title: 未来主义 Logo 交易卡
content: A futuristic trading card with a dark, moody neon aesthetic and soft sci-fi lighting. The card features a semi-transparent rounded rectangle with slightly muted glowing edges, appearing as if made of holographic glass. At its center floats the emblem of a fictional AI company: a minimalist geometric owl inside a hexagon, rendered in a cyan-to-violet gradient. The card top reads "NOCTUA LABS", the bottom reads "FOUNDER SERIES · 001". Subtle circuit traces and floating particles decorate the card. 3:2 landscape, ultra-detailed, premium collectible feel.
